scope: Exploratory analysis of already exposed saved V5 pilot predictions; not confirmation, not preregistration
primary_summary: Mean individual-seed RMSE; deterministic controls appear once
error_sign: prediction minus target, in raw sigma7 units
residual_diagnostics: Mincer-Zarnowitz joint intercept0 slope1 with HAC14
multiplicity: One Holm128 family across32 frozen trajectories*4 diagnostics; unsupported diagnostics retain a p=1 position
bias_intervals: 64 pointwise asymptotic normal HAC intervals, bandwidth7 and14; no simultaneous or finite-sample coverage claim

temporal_intervals.paired_unit: One date index matrix shared by every recipe and every stored seed; no iid row or separate model resampling
temporal_intervals.initialization_scope: Conditional on the five stored seed trajectories; no seed resampling or seed-population confidence claim
temporal_intervals.contrasts: candidate minus all7 other pilot recipes; mean individual-seed RMSE and secondary MAE
temporal_intervals.multiplicity: Intervals are pointwise sensitivity diagnostics, not simultaneous and not Holm-adjusted; no p values or superiority decisions
temporal_intervals.limitations: Only55 dates, assumed approximate stationarity and weak dependence, circular seam artificial, effective blocks about3.9..7.9, finite-sample coverage not validated

adequacy_constraints: No saved fit/selection point predictions or selected-checkpoint fit loss. No full TablesA/B hypothesis or prospective gap margin can be reconstructed. No saved predictive quantiles or law for coverage/PIT.
